title: Get started
goal: A first flight: send it somewhere, stop it, bring it home and land.

steps.text: Press Go to in the Control tab, then click a place on the map.
steps.hint: Go to sends it to the place you clicked and holds it there.

steps.text: Choose BRAKE in the Mode menu in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Brake stops it where it is and holds it there.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Control tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch flies it home and lands it there by itself.

steps.text: Press Land in the Control tab, or wait for it to land at home.
steps.hint: Land brings it straight down where it is. This step ticks once it's on the ground.

passed: Done. It's back on the ground.
